scope: 18 distinct real task URLs: 10 development snapshots, 8 reserved snapshots. Engineering source adjudication, not non-author human acceptance or economic truth.

capture.reserved: Raw HTTP only, no production extractor/verifier, no output generation; one planned capture per URL; failures/policy refusals remain.
capture.robots: Read robots first; respect disallow. No challenge solving, identity rotation, paid provider or model.
capture.resourceGate: No actual full tests, acceptance runner or API CLI active; never touch port8787 or another process.

annotation.grain: One required field within one identified source record; context unit/date are explicit known/unknown/not_applicable states.
annotation.candidateEvaluationReserved: not run; must explicitly unseal later; any tuning exposure reclassifies sample as development.
annotation.rawAndLabels: Private ignored .w2l dataset and artifact archive; no raw pages or batch outputs committed.
